theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  have h_subset_or_compl : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have h₁ : A ∉ P := h.1
    have h₂ : Aᶜ ∉ P := h.2
    have h₃ : ∃ U ∈ P, A ∩ U = ∅ := by
      by_contra h₃
      push_neg at h₃
      have h₄ : ∀ U ∈ P, A ∩ U ≠ ∅ := by
        intro U hU
        exact (Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mp (h₃ U hU))
      exact hPS ⟨A, h₁, h₄⟩
    have h₄ : ∃ U ∈ P, Aᶜ ∩ U = ∅ := by
      by_contra h₄
      push_neg at h₄
      have h₅ : ∀ U ∈ P, Aᶜ ∩ U ≠ ∅ := by
        intro U hU
        exact (Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mp (h₄ U hU))
      exact hPS ⟨Aᶜ, h₂, h₅⟩
    obtain ⟨U₁, hU₁, hU₁_empty⟩ := h₃
    obtain ⟨U₂, hU₂, hU₂_empty⟩ := h₄
    have h₅ : U₁ ∩ U₂ = ∅ := by
      have h₅₁ : U₁ ⊆ Aᶜ := by
        intro x hx
        by_contra h₅₁
        have h₅₂ : x ∈ A := by simpa using h₅₁
        have h₅₃ : x ∈ A ∩ U₁ := ⟨h₅₂, hx⟩
        exact Set.not_mem_empty x (hU₁_empty ▸ h₅₃)
      have h₅₂ : U₂ ⊆ A := by
        intro x hx
        by_contra h₅₂
        have h₅₃ : x ∈ Aᶜ := by simpa using h₅₂
        have h₅₄ : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ U₂ := ⟨h₅₃, hx⟩
        exact Set.not_mem_empty x (hU₂_empty ▸ h₅₄)
      have h₅₃ : U₁ ∩ U₂ ⊆ Aᶜ ∩ A := Set.inter_subset_inter h₅₁ h₅₂
      have h₅₄ : Aᶜ ∩ A = ∅ := by simp
      rw [h₅₄] at h₅₃
      exact Set.subset_empty_iff.mp h₅₃
    have h₆ : U₁ ∩ U₂ ≠ ∅ := hPP U₁ hU₁ U₂ hU₂
    exact h₆ h₅
  
  have h_not_both : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hAc
    have h₂ : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by
      ext x
      simp
    have h₃ : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc
    rw [h₂] at h₃
    contradiction
  
  classical
  
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := Finset.univ \ P
  
  have h₁ : P.card = Q.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    · intro A hA
      simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_univ, true_and] at hA ⊢
      cases h_subset_or_compl A with
      | inl h => exact h_not_both A h
      | inr h => contradiction
    · intro A hA
      simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_univ, true_and] at hA ⊢
      cases h_subset_or_compl A with
      | inl h => contradiction
      | inr h => exact h
    · intro A hA; simp [Set.compl_compl]
    · intro A hA; simp [Set.compl_compl]
  
  have h₂ : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← Finset.card_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ P), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
  
  have : 0 < Fintype.card S := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨default⟩
  have h₃ : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel this.le]
  
  rw [← h₃]
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right (by norm_num : 0 < 2)
  rw [← h₂, h₁]
  ring

(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by 
  
  
  have h_subset_or_compl : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by grind
    
  
  have h_not_both : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA
    by_contra h
    
    have h₂ : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by
      ext x
      simp
      
    have h₃ : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A hA Aᶜ h

  let Q : Finset (Set S) := (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) \ P
  
  have h₁ : P.card = Q.card := by
    
    have h₂ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := by grind
    have h₃ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := by grind
    
    
    
    
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    <;> simp_all
  
  have h₂ : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h₃ : P.card + Q.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by grind
    have h₄ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
      simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
      
      
      
      
      
    omega
  
  
  
  have h₄ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := by
    
    have h₆ : 0 < Fintype.card S := by positivity
    omega
  
  
  have h₈ : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h₉ : Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S := by
      
      omega
    calc
      2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 ^ 1 := by exact rfl
      _ = 2 ^ ((Fintype.card S - 1) + 1) := by
